canonical_statement: The report describes recurrent USA300 MRSA cutaneous abscesses in one patient and evaluates the emergence of reduced chlorhexidine susceptibility in the second clinical isolate.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: We describe the selection of reduced chlorhexidine susceptibility during chlorhexidine use in a patient with two episodes

canonical_statement: The patient was an 18-year-old man undergoing infantry basic training at Fort Benning, Georgia, with no reported prior history of cutaneous abscesses.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: An 18-year-old man undergoing infantry basic training at Fort Benning, GA

population.label: 18-year-old male infantry basic trainee with recurrent cutaneous MRSA abscesses

canonical_statement: The first episode was a left prepatellar cutaneous abscess that yielded MRSA on wound culture and resolved after incision and drainage, TMP-SMX, and wound care.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: The patient was diagnosed with a cutaneous abscess without joint involvement and underwent incision and drainage.

canonical_statement: For the first abscess, the patient underwent incision and drainage and received a 10-day course of twice-daily double-strength trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: the patient was treated with a 10-day course of twice-daily double-strength TMP-SMX

canonical_statement: The first abscess completely resolved within 14 days after treatment and follow-up wound care.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: complete resolution of his abscess within 14 days

canonical_statement: Nine weeks after the first presentation, the patient developed a second MRSA cutaneous abscess on the dorsum of the left foot.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Nine weeks after his initial presentation, the patient returned to the clinic.

canonical_statement: The patient was assigned 4% chlorhexidine gluconate for weekly showering in a prevention trial but reported actual use every other week, approximately 1-2 uses before the first abscess and 4-5 uses before the second.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: he reported using the agent every other week throughout his training

exposures.details: Trial protocol specified weekly showering; self-reported exposure was less frequent

canonical_statement: Both abscess isolates were ST8 USA300, SCCmec type IV, PVL-positive, and mupA-negative; C01 was qacA-negative while C02 was qacA-positive.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: qacA                          Negative               Positive

canonical_statement: The second isolate C02 was levofloxacin-resistant whereas C01 was levofloxacin-susceptible; their other listed antimicrobial susceptibility results were otherwise the same.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Levofloxacin                Susceptible            Resistant

canonical_statement: At the second episode, anterior-nares sampling identified a separate, unrelated ST30 methicillin-susceptible Staphylococcus aureus strain.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: methicillin-susceptible S. aureus strain (ST30)

canonical_statement: The chlorhexidine MIC increased from 0.3 micrograms/mL for C01 to 0.8 micrograms/mL for C02, approximately a 2.7-fold increase.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: the MIC for the C01 isolate was 0.3

population.label: Two clinical USA300 MRSA abscess isolates from one patient

outcome.definition: MIC determined after overnight growth in broth containing chlorhexidine concentrations from 0 to 1 microgram/mL

quantitative_result.effect_measure: fold change in chlorhexidine MIC (C02 vs C01)
quantitative_result.original_result_text: MIC of chlorhexidine for C01 was 0.3 micrograms/mL and for C02 was 0.8 micrograms/mL, an approximate 2.7-fold increase.

canonical_statement: Chlorhexidine susceptibility testing inoculated approximately 4 x 10^4 CFU into cation-adjusted Mueller-Hinton II broth with 0-1 microgram/mL chlorhexidine and incubated overnight with shaking.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Both clinical isolates underwent chlorhexidine susceptibility testing.

canonical_statement: The C01 and C02 norA promoter sequences were identical and norA expression in C02 was indistinguishable from C01.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: the C01 and C02 norA promoters were identical in nucleotide composition

canonical_statement: qacA was detected and actively expressed in C02 but not in C01.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: C02 isolate actively expressed the qacA gene

canonical_statement: Sequence comparison supported identification of the C02 gene as qacA: six of seven distinguishing qacA residues were present, with an alternative lysine start codon at the first position.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: six of the qacA residues were observed in the qacA gene from C02

canonical_statement: A 10-primer-pair PCR panel spanning pSK1 was used to test whether the qacA-containing C02 plasmid was pSK1.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: TABLE 2 pSK1-like plasmid PCR primer panel

canonical_statement: Only pSK1 primer pair 9, which encompassed qacA, produced the expected C02 amplicon; the authors concluded the gene may be on a pSK1-like plasmid but not pSK1 itself.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: only the primer pair that encompassed the qacA gene (primer pair 9) yielded a PCR amplicon

canonical_statement: The two clinical isolates underwent Pacific Biosciences RS II SMRT whole-genome sequencing, yielding a closed circular chromosome and plasmid for each isolate.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: subjected to Pacific Biosciences RS II SMRT whole-genome sequencing

canonical_statement: Whole-genome comparison found more than 140 chromosomal SNPs between C01 and C02, supporting that the two isolates were genetically distinct.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: we observed >140 single nucleotide polymorphisms (SNPs) between the two chromosomes

canonical_statement: C02 contained gyrA S84L and grlA F80Y substitutions that the authors considered likely explanations for the isolate's levofloxacin resistance.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: These SNPs result in an S84L amino acid mutation in GyrA and an F80Y mutation in GrlA

canonical_statement: Table 3 reported chromosomes of 2,918,599 bp (C01) and 2,864,998 bp (C02), and plasmids of 27,044 bp (pC01) and 61,537 bp (pC02).

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: TABLE 3 Genome and plasmid statistics

canonical_statement: Less than 40% of pC02 matched regions in other NCBI sequences, and the authors described the qacA-containing pC02 plasmid as apparently novel.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: less than 40% of the plasmid contained regions similar to those of other sequences in the NCBI database

canonical_statement: The pC02 annotation included proteins involved in DNA replication, transcriptional regulation, and substrate translocation, including Ssb, TopB, QacR, and CadC.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: FIG 2 Annotated map of the pC02 plasmid.

canonical_statement: The authors state that there are no established breakpoints for chlorhexidine resistance and that qacA/B presence and increased MIC can be poorly correlated.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: there are no established breakpoints for chlorhexidine resistance

canonical_statement: The authors could not determine the overall clinical impact of the reduced chlorhexidine susceptibility beyond noting that the patient developed a second USA300 MRSA abscess.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: We cannot determine the overall clinical impact of this reduced chlorhexidine susceptibility in our patient

canonical_statement: The authors state that chlorhexidine use every other week may have contributed to selection of reduced susceptibility, but phrase this as a possibility rather than established causality.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: this may have played a part in the selection of reduced chlorhexidine susceptibility in the patient

canonical_statement: The authors describe this as the first reported selection for increased chlorhexidine MICs during chlorhexidine use in community-associated recurrent USA300 MRSA SSTI and recommend further surveillance and study.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Further study and surveillance for the emergence of chlorhexidine resistance should be considered

canonical_statement: The C01 and C02 genomes and plasmids were deposited in NCBI under accession numbers CP012118, CP012119, CP012120, and CP012121.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: The C01 and C02 genomes and plasmids were submitted to NCBI and given accession no.
